messages.author: 07b848371b1643ce
messages.subject: distsamp and multiple visits
parts:
I'm interested in using distsamp to estimate density from point-count
surveys. In DISTANCE, I could specify "effort" to account for
repeated visits to the same point. From the reading I've done, I
don't see a way to do this in distsamp, but perhaps I am missing
something? Any advice on distance sampling with unmarked if one has
multiple visits to a point?

Thank you,
Nat

messages.author: df74d6fccec2ff7e
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] distsamp and multiple visits
parts:
This issue came up again off-list. In some cases it is probably reasonable to model the log number of visits as an offset, ie

distsamp(~1 ~offset(log(visits)), umf)

Someone tried this and told me it gave identical estimates to program DISTANCE, but if you are trying to be consistent with that program, you had better do the comparison yourself because I have not looked into how DISTANCE treats variation in "effort".

Richard
